visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Leftover Elements Are Lost
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Merging 1 5 8 with 2 3 4 20 30 should end with 20 30, but the program prints zeros in those places.

solution.explanation: The main loop stops as soon as one array runs out, and the other array may still hold elements. Those leftovers are already sorted, so each array needs its own loop that copies the remainder.
